name: ooeyama-shuten-confrontation
reviewNotes: All 35 records from the current original-ROM catalog; original glyphs visually reviewed; not integrated into v42.
Opponent and winner names remain dynamic [09] values; natural selection and battle branches still require verification.
Names follow the existing enemy and item tables: 金童子, 熊童子, 虎熊童子, 星熊童子, 三日月水晶.
